hero.title: Your staff know things these students can't easily find out
hero.body: You can list employees as mentors, cover the cost of a school talk, or fund a full term of them. It also meets a CSR objective.

ways.title: Ways to get involved
ways.body: None of it needs a budget to get started. Most companies begin with four or five staff who are willing to take part.

items.title: List staff as mentors
items.body: Employees who opt in are listed under their industry, and schools can ask them questions or invite them in for a visit. They only commit to what they agree to, and their contact details stay private.

items.title: Cover a talk
items.body: Pay a mentor's fee for their time and travel, usually €50 to €150, so a school can bring someone in without having to find the money itself.

items.title: Sponsor the platform
items.body: Annual sponsorship of €2,000 to €10,000 pays for the coordination that keeps the directory free for the schools that need it. In return you're credited as a partner.

cta.title: Worth a conversation?
cta.body: Let us know roughly what you have in mind, even if it's just a few willing staff to start with. We'll work out what fits from there.
